protocol_amendment.reason: The exact-commit V9 red-team review found that public build_legacy_row still performed non-frozen factor-base, expansion, graph, optimizer, and retained-model work even though its output was not admissible as V9 evidence. A coordinator fault-injection probe also showed that suppressing any one completed-path graph or expansion charge left an otherwise valid frozen document valid because those counters were checked only against upper bounds. Theory review separately identified wording that overstated the structurally separate secondary proof available outside frozen B4.
changes: Accept only the V10 document schema and reject V1-V9 without row verification.

Replace public build_legacy_row with a fail-before-work guard and replace its broad implementation with the frozen-only _build_frozen_legacy_control_row(B) helper, which admits exact integer B in {4,6,8} before constructing the frozen curve.
Keep public generated_curve disabled and keep build_density_row restricted to the exact frozen p=19 B4 association before factor-base work.
Snapshot the four graph and expansion counters before each row reconstruction and require exact successful deltas derived from the reconstructed candidate count, eligible count, and factor-base size.
Keep interrupted graph and expansion paths unchanged: charge inside loops, preserve exact partial lower bounds, mark the row work incomplete, and fail the aggregate unit.
Add controls that suppress each completed graph or expansion charge and overcharge one candidate evaluation; require row invalidation while actual_work_complete remains true.
Extend the producer-surface control so both public row-producing entry points reject a non-frozen association before factor-base work.

Clarify the stopping rule: every canonical cell needs independent primary proof and deterministic complete secondary replay, while frozen B4 additionally needs standalone complete five-field agreement.
Keep every development family-row and canonical run budget at zero.
unchanged_mathematical_boundary: The curve grid, predicates, four null replicates, representative compiler, ordering digest, graph object, cap schedule, five-field objective, matched-null thresholds, positive gate, and negative classification remain unchanged.
Exactness remains finite, TOY-EVIDENCE, and MODEL-BOUND to the fixed compiler and order-ideal construction.
The standalone complete five-field semantic oracle remains frozen-B4 only; B6 and B8 secondary objective fields remain deterministic replay confirmations.
No relation generation, rank, linear algebra, target descent, fixed-curve preprocessing crossover, rho comparison, exponent, deployment, or ECDLP result is in scope.
residual_external_resource_boundary: The in-process reservation and actual counters are structural combinatorial receipts, not CPU, wall-time, parser, allocator, RSS, disk, I/O, cache-traffic, or memory-bandwidth models.
Canonical B6 and B8 feasibility, output size, cache occupancy, and role resource use remain unmeasured.
The module-load verifier digest is diagnostic only; a future runner must bind the exact commit, command, environment, and immutable input/output paths.
protocol_amendment.required_next_review: Validate and commit one exact V10 snapshot, then obtain fresh independent theory, accounting, and red-team review. Three scoped GO decisions could authorize only a separate hash-complete launch-plan design, not execution.
